_comment: 死士检查配置示例（占位符需替换；真实配置含密码，放项目侧不进 skill）
notify_cmd: python3 <项目目录>/scripts/deadman_notify.py   # 内容从 stdin 读，不用占位符

checks.name: 静态扫描-判定心跳
checks.freshness_sql: SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM community_commits WHERE tdsql_need_merge IS NOT NULL
checks.gate_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_commits WHERE tdsql_need_merge IS NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(main_diff,''))>0

checks.name: 动态复现-产出
checks.count_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mtr_test_result WHERE created_at >= ?

checks.name: 队列水位
checks.pending_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_commits WHERE tdsql_need_merge IS NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(IFNULL(main_diff,''))>0
checks.judged_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_commits WHERE tdsql_need_merge IS NOT NULL AND updated_at >= ?

checks.name: taskctl 队列（skill 自身）
checks.pending_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status='queued'
checks.judged_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status IN ('done','failed') AND ended_at >= ?
